description: Chooses which part of a shot's photo each version shows: Wide (16:9), Square (1:1) or Phone (9:16). Uses no credit; undoable. A version's framing is its own: framing Phone leaves Wide and Square alone. There are four ways to frame, one per call: (a) focusX, focusY (0 to 1, where in the photo the frame centers; 0.5 is the middle) and zoom (1 to 3); (b) a nudge: zoomBy (zoom in is +0.25 for a bit), moveX / moveY (-0.1 moves the frame a little left or up, +0.1 right or down; the frame moves, so the picture appears to slide the other way); (c) frames: one {photoId, focusX, focusY, zoom} per shot, for when each shot needs its own frame (find_framing returns ready frames); or (d) reset true to go back to the default framing. aspect 'all' frames every version at once; a reset with 'all' clears the framing completely.

allShots.description: Frame every shot in the video.

aspect.description: Which version: wide, square, phone, or all.

focusX.description: Where the frame centers across the photo, 0 (left) to 1 (right); 0.5 is the middle.

focusY.description: Where the frame centers down the photo, 0 (top) to 1 (bottom); 0.5 is the middle.

frames.description: One frame per shot, for shots that each need their own (find_framing returns them).

focusX.description: Where this shot's frame centers across the photo, 0 to 1.

focusY.description: Where this shot's frame centers down the photo, 0 to 1.

photoId.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".

zoom.description: How far in this shot's frame is, 1 to 3.

moveX.description: A nudge sideways, -1 to 1; -0.1 moves the frame a little left.

moveY.description: A nudge up or down, -1 to 1; -0.1 moves the frame a little up.

photoIds.description: The shots to frame. Not needed with allShots or frames.

items.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".

reset.description: true goes back to the default framing.

zoom.description: How far in the frame is, 1 (whole photo) to 3.

zoomBy.description: A nudge to the current zoom, -2 to 2; +0.25 is a bit closer.

name: frame_shot
title: Frame a shot
